searchText: Is there a reason that this community relies so much on the from the privacy point of view rather objectionable services of Telegram? Why not use Matrix? Open Standards for the win. Matrix does have a *lot* of protocol design issues for what it's worth, having used it for ~6 years now I agree. But I happily trade handing my privacy to some entity with unclear Russian ties for the inconvenience of infrequent Matrix hiccups. Also Telegram hosts a lot of objectionable content.
